tools.name: search-library
tools.title: Search Library
tools.description: Search the user's saved videos, podcasts, articles, threads and notes. Returns passages with timestamps and links to the exact moment.

tools.name: get-library-item
tools.title: Get Library Item
tools.description: Open one saved item by its ID or slug and return its source and timestamped excerpts.

tools.name: list-recent-uoinks
tools.title: List Recent Uoinks
tools.description: List the newest items saved to the library.

tools.name: uoink-link
tools.title: Uoink Link
tools.description: Save a link (YouTube, X, Reddit, podcast feed or web article) into the user's library. Asks for confirmation first.

tools.name: save-note
tools.title: Save Note
tools.description: Save text as a searchable note in the user's library. Asks for confirmation first.

tools.name: mention-library
tools.title: Library Items
tools.description: Mention a saved item in AI Chat to give the AI its timestamped excerpts.

ai.instructions: Uoink is the user's local library of saved YouTube videos, podcasts, web articles, X posts, Reddit threads and notes. It runs on the user's computer; nothing is fetched from a Uoink cloud. Answer questions about saved material from search-library or get-library-item results only, and never invent quotes, titles or timestamps. When a result has a timestamp and link, cite it as a Markdown link such as [Video title @ 12:34](link). Quote a passage word for word only when passageVerified is true; otherwise paraphrase and say the match is approximate. If search returns nothing, say so and suggest other key words. Only call uoink-link or save-note when the user explicitly asks to save, capture or uoink something.
